findings.summary: SGDR mechanism FINAL STATUS (unchanged from twice-recomputed round-1 evidence, now independently re-gated): REPRODUCED_USEFUL / VALIDATED_USEFUL at PROOF OF CONCEPT ceiling. Binding maximum-defensible wording (from the delivered state file): SGDR-style stepwise retrieval scored by alpha*cos(task_goal, desc) + (1-alpha)*cos(current_state_summary, desc), pool top-M=max(3k,20), greedy MMR lambda=0.7 retrieved executable-correct fragments strictly more often than task-text-only retrieval with identical reranking under paraphrased goals + shifted entry contexts (36/74 vs 25/74 correct@1; 11 paired wins / 0 reversals); logged hard@1 aggregates reprinted identically at delivery: A 0/74, B 25/74, C 36/74, D 19/74. Gain requires the CORRECT current-state summary (wrong-context summary or summary-only score falls back to baseline level, both 24/74). Converted into fewer novel exploration actions than task-only retrieval at equal-or-higher subgoal success (.90/.90 vs .90/.80; 39 vs 42 literal, 36 vs 42 paraphrase novel actions). Advantage concentrated in one site's dynamic-content menu-disambiguation cluster; NO advantage for login/pager addressing; exact hand-authored goal_sig remains more action-efficient where it exists (21 vs 39 novel on literal slice). Validated configuration ONLY: lexical-hash embedder, deterministic contract-faithful summarizer. Not established: WebArena-scale effects, neural embedders, LLM summarizers, larger libraries, cross-site transfer.
